programs.title: Space & AI
programs.short: Students explore space science and artificial intelligence through practical activities.
programs.description: Our core program brings space science and artificial intelligence to younger students through hands-on activities, demonstrations, and projects. Students explore ideas by making things and trying them out.

topics.name: Space science
topics.text: Explore rockets, parachutes, and the engineering behind space exploration.

topics.name: Artificial intelligence
topics.text: Get a first look at how computers learn from information and how people use AI.

topics.name: Hands-on projects
topics.text: Build, test, and change a design to see what happens.

programs.note: Programs have included sessions at Welch Elementary and the Alive Center. Ages, dates, and cost depend on the location. Contact the team for the next available session.

programs.title: Python & Neural Networks
programs.short: High school students learn Python and the basics of neural networks.
programs.description: A beginner-friendly introduction to Python and the ideas behind neural networks. Across four sessions, high school students move from core programming concepts to exploring an AI project.

topics.name: Python foundations
topics.text: Get comfortable writing code and working with core Python concepts.

topics.name: Python libraries
topics.text: Explore tools that help you work with data and build projects.

topics.name: Neural networks
topics.text: Understand the basic ideas behind how an AI system learns.

topics.name: An AI project
topics.text: Bring the ideas together in a beginner-level project.

programs.note: The listed dates are from the completed Summer 2026 camp. Contact AstroThink to ask about future sessions. No prior coding experience was required.

programs.title: Beyond the Stethoscope
programs.short: Middle school students explore healthcare careers, the immune system, and new medical technology.
programs.description: A three-session healthcare exploration program created with Aurora Public Library. Students explore healthcare careers, the body's defenses, and new medical technology through case studies and group problem-solving.

topics.name: Inside healthcare
topics.text: Explore healthcare settings, the people who work in them, and a patient's journey through care.

topics.name: The science of staying healthy
topics.text: Learn about bacteria, viruses, and the immune system, then work through a case study.

topics.name: The future of medicine
topics.text: Explore new technology, AI, and machine learning in medicine before presenting a final case study.

programs.note: The Summer 2026 program was held in the Teen Programming Room at Aurora Public Library. The listed session has concluded; contact the team about future programs.

programs.title: Career Pathways
programs.short: Students meet guest speakers and ask questions about their work and education.
programs.description: A five-week speaker program for students thinking about high school and what comes next. Guests share their work and answer questions about different fields, including engineering, law, research, and writing.

topics.name: Different fields
topics.text: Hear about the daily work behind careers you may have considered, and discover others.

topics.name: Real conversations
topics.text: Ask guest speakers about their experiences, decisions, and routes into their fields.

topics.name: Your own interests
topics.text: Use what you hear to think about the subjects and opportunities you want to explore.

programs.note: These details describe the completed Summer 2026 program at the 95th Street Library. Contact the team to ask about the next series.
